title: facts-cv-v2 (ACTIVE, rev 7 — team-ratified 2026-07)

courses_taught.$comment: unchanged from v1: codes exactly as printed; informational only

education.$comment: EXTRACTIVE TIER: every value verbatim-traceable to the CV

institution.$comment: null when the CV prints a degree line with no institution (real corpus case)

degree.$comment: as printed, e.g. 'Doctor of Philosophy'; null when the CV prints an education stint with no degree line (real case: '2004-2006: Collin County Community College')

experience.$comment: EXTRACTIVE TIER: one entry per printed position; dates as printed

organization.$comment: null when the CV prints a role with no organization (real corpus case)

role.$comment: null when the CV prints an organization/date stint with no role title (real corpus case)

category.$comment: from the CV's own section headings when present ('Teaching Experience', 'Industry Experience'); otherwise from the role title, never guessed from the org name alone

publications.$comment: EXTRACTIVE TIER: census of the printed list, never a bibliography copy

venues_sample.$comment: distinct venue/conference names as printed, up to 8

computed.$comment: COMPUTED TIER: written by pipeline post-processing (pure Python over the extractive tier) — THE EXTRACTOR MUST OUTPUT null. Durations are UNIONS of printed year-ranges (overlapping roles never double-count); 'Present' resolves to the scrape year.

computed_as_of.$comment: scrape year used to resolve 'Present'; the answer layer may recompute open-ended durations live from the stored ranges

derived_profile.$comment: DERIVED TIER: model judgment, every claim evidence-cited with a verbatim CV quote (mechanically checked present-in-source). Professional facts only — never infer personal attributes beyond what the CV states. null ONLY for empty-shell CVs — mechanically checkable trigger: education [] AND experience [] AND publications null AND certifications []; if any extractive tier is non-empty, an object is mandatory (verify_cv enforces both directions).

orientation.$comment: hybrid = substantial evidence on 2+ axes (e.g. long industry tenure AND a research publication record)

topic.$comment: short normalized tag, e.g. 'natural language processing'

evidence.$comment: VERBATIM quote from the CV that supports this tag

currency.$comment: COMPUTED-VERIFIED: current = supporting role is_current or evidence within 3y of scrape; recent = within 8y; historical = older. The extractor proposes, compute_cv.py recomputes and overrides.

evidence_years.$comment: [min,max] years of the supporting evidence (publication years or role range)

summary.$comment: target <=120 words (hard cap 150), neutral; becomes the row's chunk_text (embedded). Must reflect orientation, top topics, notable organizations/countries, and the COMPUTED duration figures — never invented ones. The extractor writes duration figures as placeholder tokens ({{years_teaching}}, {{years_industry}}, {{years_research_role}}, {{years_teaching_industry_overlap}}); compute_cv.py substitutes real values, so the extractor never does arithmetic. Figures printed verbatim in the CV (publication counts, years) may appear literally.

archetype.$comment: one plain-language phrase a student can repeat; descriptive, no evaluative adjectives

career_path.$comment: DERIVED TIER: ordered narrative of the printed positions

notes.$comment: ambiguity record per the general rules (rule 4: medium confidence -> note the resolved ambiguity here); adjudication-facing, never embedded

teaching_record.$comment: COMPOSED TIER: joined from registrar schedule/section data by instructor_slug at load time — THE EXTRACTOR MUST OUTPUT null. More objective than the CV (not self-reported); refreshed every term.

title.$comment: printed class name from the schedule CSVs — codes alone are unreadable to students

$comment: DRAFT v2 (rev 7, 2026-07-26 late: experience.role also nullable, 2 bulk CVs print org+date stints without role titles. Rev 6 — rev 3: derived_profile nullable for empty shells + summary placeholder tokens; rev 4: education.degree nullable; rev 5: teaching_record course titles; rev 6, from the first 170 bulk CVs: education.institution and experience.organization nullable (CVs print degree lines and roles without them), optional root notes field (the general rules instruct the model to record resolved ambiguities there — additionalProperties:false without it forced 6 CVs into quarantine), summary word limit is target 120 / hard cap 150): four-tier CV profiling — extractive (verbatim-traceable) / computed (pipeline arithmetic; extractor outputs null; ranges are the source of truth, durations always derivable) / composed (teaching_record joined from registrar data; extractor outputs null) / derived (evidence-cited judgment; currency prevents stale interests reading as current; no evaluative adjectives; no personal-attribute inference). Every answer built on a cv row MUST surface source_url so students can verify. Supersedes facts-cv-v1 (team-ratified 2026-07). Evolving a shape = copy to v3.
